verses.en: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
verses.pt: Ao cumprir-se o dia de Pentecostes, estavam todos reunidos no mesmo lugar.
verses.en_web: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.
verses.en_bbe: And when the day of Pentecost was come, they were all together in one place.

verses.en: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
verses.pt: De repente veio do céu um ruído, como que de um vento impetuoso, e encheu toda a casa onde estavam sentados.
verses.en_web: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
verses.en_bbe: And suddenly there came from heaven a sound like the rushing of a violent wind, and all the house where they were was full of it.

verses.en: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
verses.pt: E lhes apareceram umas línguas como que de fogo, que se distribuíam, e sobre cada um deles pousou uma.
verses.en_web: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.
verses.en_bbe: And they saw tongues, like flames of fire, coming to rest on every one of them.

verses.en: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
verses.pt: E todos ficaram cheios do Espírito Santo, e começaram a falar noutras línguas, conforme o Espírito lhes concedia que falassem.
verses.en_web: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.
verses.en_bbe: And they were all full of the Holy Spirit, and were talking in different languages, as the Spirit gave them power.

verses.en: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
verses.pt: Habitavam então em Jerusalém judeus, homens piedosos, de todas as nações que há debaixo do céu.
verses.en_web: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.
verses.en_bbe: Now there were living at Jerusalem, Jews, God-fearing men, from every nation under heaven.

verses.en: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
verses.pt: Ouvindo-se, pois, aquele ruído, ajuntou-se a multidão; e estava confusa, porque cada um os ouvia falar na sua própria língua.
verses.en_web: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together, and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.
verses.en_bbe: And when this sound came to their ears, they all came together, and were greatly surprised because every man was hearing the words of the disciples in his special language.

verses.en: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?
verses.pt: E todos pasmavam e se admiravam, dizendo uns aos outros: Pois quê! não são galileus todos esses que estão falando?
verses.en_web: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?
verses.en_bbe: And they were full of wonder and said, Are not all these men Galilaeans?

verses.en: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
verses.pt: Como é, pois, que os ouvimos falar cada um na própria língua em que nascemos?
verses.en_web: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?
verses.en_bbe: And how is it that every one of us is hearing their words in the language which was ours from our birth?

verses.en: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
verses.pt: Nós, partos, medos, e elamitas; e os que habitamos a Mesopotâmia, a Judéia e a Capadócia, o Ponto e a Ásia,
verses.en_web: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
verses.en_bbe: Men of Parthia, Media, and Elam, and those living in Mesopotamia, in Judaea and Cappadocia, in Pontus and Asia,

verses.en: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
verses.pt: a Frígia e a Panfília, o Egito e as partes da Líbia próximas a Cirene, e forasteiros romanos, tanto judeus como prosélitos,
verses.en_web: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
verses.en_bbe: In Phrygia and Pamphylia, in Egypt and the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and those who have come from Rome, Jews by birth and others who have become Jews,

verses.en: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
verses.pt: cretenses e árabes - ouvímo-los em nossas línguas, falar das grandezas de Deus.
verses.en_web: Cretans and Arabians: we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”
verses.en_bbe: Men of Crete and Arabia, to all of us they are talking in our different languages, of the great works of God.

verses.en: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
verses.pt: E todos pasmavam e estavam perplexos, dizendo uns aos outros: Que quer dizer isto?
verses.en_web: They were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”
verses.en_bbe: And they were all surprised and in doubt saying to one another, What is the reason of this?

verses.en: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
verses.pt: E outros, zombando, diziam: Estão cheios de mosto.
verses.en_web: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”
verses.en_bbe: But others, making sport of them, said, They are full of new wine.

verses.en: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
verses.pt: Então Pedro, pondo-se em pé com os onze, levantou a voz e disse-lhes: Varões judeus e todos os que habitais em Jerusalém, seja- vos isto notório, e escutai as minhas palavras.
verses.en_web: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea, and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.
verses.en_bbe: But Peter, getting up, with the eleven, said in a loud voice, O men of Judaea, and all you who are living in Jerusalem, take note of this and give ear to my words.

verses.en: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
verses.pt: Pois estes homens não estão embriagados, como vós pensais, visto que é apenas a terceira hora do dia.
verses.en_web: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.
verses.en_bbe: For these men are not overcome with wine, as it seems to you, for it is only the third hour of the day;

verses.en: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
verses.pt: Mas isto é o que foi dito pelo profeta Joel:
verses.en_web: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:
verses.en_bbe: But this is the thing which was said by the prophet Joel;

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
verses.pt: E acontecerá nos últimos dias, diz o Senhor, que derramarei do meu Espírito sobre toda a carne; e os vossos filhos e as vossas filhas profetizarão, os vossos mancebos terão visões, os vossos anciãos terão sonhos;
verses.en_web: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.
verses.en_bbe: And it will come about, in the last days, says God, that I will send out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will be prophets, and your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams:

verses.en: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
verses.pt: e sobre os meus servos e sobre as minhas servas derramarei do meu Espírito naqueles dias, e eles profetizarão.
verses.en_web: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.
verses.en_bbe: And on my men-servants and my women-servants I will send my Spirit, and they will be prophets.

verses.en: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
verses.pt: E mostrarei prodígios em cima no céu; e sinais embaixo na terra, sangue, fogo e vapor de fumaça.
verses.en_web: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.
verses.en_bbe: And wonders will be seen in heaven, and signs on the earth, blood and fire and smoke:

verses.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
verses.pt: O sol se converterá em trevas, e a lua em sangue, antes que venha o grande e glorioso dia do Senhor.
verses.en_web: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.
verses.en_bbe: The sun will become dark and the moon will be turned to blood, before that great day of the Lord comes in glory:

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.pt: e acontecerá que todo aquele que invocar o nome do Senhor será salvo.
verses.en_web: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
verses.en_bbe: And whoever makes his prayer to the Lord will have salvation.

verses.en: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
verses.pt: Varões israelitas, escutai estas palavras: A Jesus, o nazareno, varão aprovado por Deus entre vós com milagres, prodígios e sinais, que Deus por ele fez no meio de vós, como vós mesmos bem sabeis;
verses.en_web: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,
verses.en_bbe: Men of Israel, give ear to these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a man who had the approval of God, as was made clear to you by the great works and signs and wonders which God did by him among you, as you yourselves have knowledge,

verses.en: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
verses.pt: a este, que foi entregue pelo determinado conselho e presciência de Deus, vós matastes, crucificando-o pelas mãos de iníquos;
verses.en_web: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;
verses.en_bbe: Him, when he was given up, by the decision and knowledge of God, you put to death on the cross, by the hands of evil men:

verses.en: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
verses.pt: ao qual Deus ressuscitou, rompendo os grilhões da morte, pois não era possível que fosse retido por ela.
verses.en_web: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.
verses.en_bbe: But God gave him back to life, having made him free from the pains of death because it was not possible for him to be overcome by it.

verses.en: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
verses.pt: Porque dele fala Davi: Sempre via diante de mim o Senhor, porque está à minha direita, para que eu não seja abalado;
verses.en_web: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, For he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.
verses.en_bbe: For David said of him, I saw the Lord before my face at all times, for he is at my right hand, so that I may not be moved:

verses.en: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
verses.pt: por isso se alegrou o meu coração, e a minha língua exultou; e além disso a minha carne há de repousar em esperança;
verses.en_web: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope;
verses.en_bbe: And for this cause my heart was glad and my tongue full of joy, and my flesh will be resting in hope:

verses.en: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.pt: pois não deixarás a minha alma no hades, nem permitirás que o teu Santo veja a corrupção;
verses.en_web: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.
verses.en_bbe: For you will not let my soul be in hell and you will not give up your Holy One to destruction.

verses.en: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
verses.pt: fizeste-me conhecer os caminhos da vida; encher-me-ás de alegria na tua presença.
verses.en_web: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’
verses.en_bbe: You have made me see the ways of life; I will be full of joy when I see your face.

verses.en: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
verses.pt: Irmãos, seja-me permitido dizer-vos livremente acerca do patriarca Davi, que ele morreu e foi sepultado, e entre nós está até hoje a sua sepultura.
verses.en_web: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
verses.en_bbe: My brothers, I may say to you openly that David came to his death, and was put in the earth, and his resting-place is with us today.

verses.en: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
verses.pt: Sendo, pois, ele profeta, e sabendo que Deus lhe havia prometido com juramento que faria sentar sobre o seu trono um dos seus descendentes -
verses.en_web: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,
verses.en_bbe: But being a prophet, and having in mind the oath which God had given to him, that of the fruit of his body one would take his place as a king,

verses.en: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
verses.pt: prevendo isto, Davi falou da ressurreição de Cristo, que a sua alma não foi deixada no hades, nem a sua carne viu a corrupção.
verses.en_web: he foreseeing this spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.
verses.en_bbe: He, having knowledge of the future, was talking of the coming again of Christ from the dead, that he was not kept in hell and his body did not see destruction.

verses.en: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
verses.pt: Ora, a este Jesus, Deus ressuscitou, do que todos nós somos testemunhas.
verses.en_web: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.
verses.en_bbe: This Jesus God has given back to life, of which we all are witnesses.

verses.en: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
verses.pt: De sorte que, exaltado pela dextra de Deus, e tendo recebido do Pai a promessa do Espírito Santo, derramou isto que vós agora vedes e ouvis.
verses.en_web: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this, which you now see and hear.
verses.en_bbe: And so, being lifted up to the right hand of God, and having the Father's word that the Holy Spirit would come, he has sent this thing, which now you see and have knowledge of.

verses.en: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.pt: Porque Davi não subiu aos céus, mas ele próprio declara: Disse o Senhor ao meu Senhor: Assenta-te à minha direita,
verses.en_web: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand,
verses.en_bbe: For David has not gone up into heaven, but says, himself, The Lord said to my Lord, Be seated at my right hand,

verses.en: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
verses.pt: até que eu ponha os teus inimigos por escabelo de teus pés.
verses.en_web: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’
verses.en_bbe: Till I put all those who are against you under your feet.

verses.en: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
verses.pt: Saiba pois com certeza toda a casa de Israel que a esse mesmo Jesus, a quem vós crucificastes, Deus o fez Senhor e Cristo.
verses.en_web: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, let all Israel be certain that this Jesus, whom you put to death on the cross, God has made Lord and Christ.

verses.en: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
verses.pt: E, ouvindo eles isto, compungiram-se em seu coração, e perguntaram a Pedro e aos demais apóstolos: Que faremos, irmãos?
verses.en_web: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
verses.en_bbe: Now when these words came to their ears their hearts were troubled, and they said to Peter and the other Apostles, Brothers, what are we to do?

verses.en: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: Pedro então lhes respondeu: Arrependei-vos, e cada um de vós seja batizado em nome de Jesus Cristo, para remissão de vossos pecados; e recebereis o dom do Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: Peter said to them, “Repent, and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: And Peter said, Let your hearts be changed, every one of you, and have baptism in the name of Jesus Christ, for the forgiveness of your sins; and you will have the Holy Spirit given to you.

verses.en: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
verses.pt: Porque a promessa vos pertence a vós, a vossos filhos, e a todos os que estão longe: a quantos o Senhor nosso Deus chamar.
verses.en_web: For the promise is to you, and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”
verses.en_bbe: For the word of God is for you and for your children and for all those who are far off, even all those who may be marked out by the Lord our God.

verses.en: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
verses.pt: E com muitas outras palavras dava testemunho, e os exortava, dizendo: salvai-vos desta geração perversa.
verses.en_web: With many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
verses.en_bbe: And with more such words he gave his witness, offering them salvation and saying, Come out from this evil generation.

verses.en: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
verses.pt: De sorte que foram batizados os que receberam a sua palavra; e naquele dia agregaram-se quase três mil almas;
verses.en_web: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.
verses.en_bbe: Then those who gave hearing to his words had baptism: and about three thousand souls were joined to them that day.

verses.en: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
verses.pt: e perseveravam na doutrina dos apóstolos e na comunhão, no partir do pão e nas orações.
verses.en_web: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
verses.en_bbe: And they kept their attention fixed on the Apostles' teaching and were united together in the taking of broken bread and in prayer.

verses.en: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
verses.pt: Em cada alma havia temor, e muitos prodígios e sinais eram feitos pelos apóstolos.
verses.en_web: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
verses.en_bbe: But fear came on every soul: and all sorts of wonders and signs were done by the Apostles.

verses.en: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
verses.pt: Todos os que criam estavam unidos e tinham tudo em comum.
verses.en_web: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.
verses.en_bbe: And all those who were of the faith kept together, and had all things in common;

verses.en: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
verses.pt: E vendiam suas propriedades e bens e os repartiam por todos, segundo a necessidade de cada um.
verses.en_web: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.
verses.en_bbe: And exchanging their goods and property for money, they made division of it among them all, as they had need.

verses.en: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
verses.pt: E, perseverando unânimes todos os dias no templo, e partindo o pão em casa, comiam com alegria e singeleza de coração,
verses.en_web: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,
verses.en_bbe: And day by day, going in agreement together regularly to the Temple and, taking broken bread together in their houses, they took their food with joy and with true hearts,

verses.en: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
verses.pt: louvando a Deus, e caindo na graça de todo o povo. E cada dia acrescentava-lhes o Senhor os que iam sendo salvos.
verses.en_web: praising God, and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.
verses.en_bbe: Giving praise to God, and having the approval of all the people; and every day the number of those who had salvation was increased by the Lord.
